verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents self-hosting, where you run your own instance of the Hatchet Control Plane, so you can control where orchestration data lives by choosing where you deploy it. The community describes the task queue as backed by Postgres that you would host yourself. The pack shows no region or residency selection for Hatchet Cloud, so residency is only achievable through the self-host route. Missing for 10: managed-cloud region/residency selection, documentation explicitly addressing data residency, and independent corroboration of residency control.
